record.original_question: Assuming the partial compactification {D/T}* of a period quotient exists, can it be given the structure of an analytic space such that D/T is a Zariski open subset and the extended period mappings from compactified algebraic bases to {D/T}* are holomorphic?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $D$ be a period domain, i.e. a classifying space for polarized Hodge structures of a fixed type on a fixed lattice, and let $\Gamma$ be a discrete arithmetic group acting properly discontinuously on $D$. Consider the quotient $D/\Gamma$, which parametrizes equivalence classes of such Hodge structures, and let $\Phi : S \to D/\Gamma$ be a period mapping arising from a polarized variation of Hodge structure over a smooth quasi-projective variety $S$, where $S \subset \bar{S}$ is a smooth projective compactification with normal crossings boundary.

Assume that there exists a topological partial compactification $(D/\Gamma)^*$ containing $D/\Gamma$ as a dense open subset, with the property that every period mapping $\Phi : S \to D/\Gamma$ extends continuously to a mapping $\bar{\Phi} : \bar{S} \to (D/\Gamma)^*$.

Question: Can $(D/\Gamma)^*$ be endowed with the structure of an analytic space such that:

(i) $D/\Gamma$ is a Zariski-open subset of $(D/\Gamma)^*$, and

(ii) for every smooth projective compactification $\bar{S} \supset S$ as above, the extension $\bar{\Phi} : \bar{S} \to (D/\Gamma)^*$ is holomorphic?
artifact.status_search_result: Substantial progress has been made on this circle of conjectures. Bakker–Brunebarbe–Tsimerman, using o-minimal GAGA, proved that the image of a period map carries a canonical quasi-projective algebraic structure, settling a related Griffiths conjecture. More recent work (Bakker–Brunebarbe–Klingler–Tsimerman and others, 2023–2025) constructs functorial projective/toroidal/Baily–Borel-type compactifications of period images with holomorphic/algebraic extension properties from compactifications of algebraic bases. The original conjecture as stated for a partial compactification of the full quotient D/Γ (not merely the period image) remains not fully established in general, so the problem is best described as partially solved.

status_evidence.title: o-minimal GAGA and a conjecture of Griffiths
status_evidence.snippet: A conjecture of Griffiths on the quasi-projectivity of images of period maps has been proven using algebraization results arising from o-minimal geometry.
status_evidence.claim: A related Griffiths conjecture on the algebraic structure of period images has been proved.

status_evidence.title: Baily–Borel compactifications of period images
status_evidence.snippet: Griffiths laid out a conjectural picture which described how an analogue of the Baily–Borel compactification for arbitrary period images might exist.
status_evidence.claim: Analogues of Baily–Borel compactifications for period images have been constructed, partially realizing Griffiths' conjectural picture.

status_evidence.title: On the generalized toroidal completion of period mappings
status_evidence.snippet: For a period image Y, there exists a functorial projective compactification with extension properties for morphisms extending to Γ\D.
status_evidence.claim: Functorial projective compactifications of period images with holomorphic extension of period maps have been constructed.

status_evidence.title: Period mapping - Encyclopedia of Mathematics
status_evidence.snippet: Such a compactification is known (1983) only for the case where the period domain is a symmetric domain.
status_evidence.claim: Historically the conjecture was known only in the classical (Hermitian symmetric) case.
